info.name: Upgrade App Checker
info.summary: Check app compatibility before upgrading Nextcloud
info.description:
Upgrade with confidence — no more surprises.
Before you update Nextcloud, Upgrade App Checker scans all your installed apps and tells you exactly which ones are ready for the new version and which ones are not. Get a clear compatibility report in seconds, right from your admin panel.
✔ See at a glance which apps support your target Nextcloud version ✔ Avoid broken apps and downtime after an upgrade ✔ Plan your upgrade timeline with full visibility ✔ Works automatically in the background and keeps results fresh
Stop guessing. Know before you go.
info.author: Magnus Anderssen
